headline: Six Sectors Intensify As Bases Exchange Hands
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the war has sharpened on a half‑dozen corridors. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest theater, adding 12,072 Colonial and 17,656 Warden dead in the past 24 hours with 39 ownership changes, the most recent minutes ago. Callahans Passage follows with 11,741 Colonial and 12,786 Warden losses and ten base swaps, while Stlican Shelf records 3,110 Colonial and 3,785 Warden casualties across 27 exchanges. Nevish Line shows 6,406 Colonial and 6,633 Warden dead with 17 changes, Palantine Berm adds 410 Colonial and 405 Warden dead over 12 flips, and Kuura Strand contributes 151 Colonial and 177 Warden losses amid 11 events. Hourly casualty trends are accelerating on all six fronts and fresh enlistments are climbing sharply, signalling sustained manpower commitment. The remaining sectors stay largely static, held wholly by one faction with only low‑level attrition and no ownership activity.
